tools.name: ingest_vendor_redline
tools.description: Deterministically parse a vendor-redlined contract .docx against the standard baseline .docx using OOXML Track Changes (<w:ins>, <w:del>, <w:comment>), validate with ExtractedClauseDiff, and persist all clause deviations to BigQuery (vertex-ai-demos-468803.boeing_clm).

vendor_docx_path.description: Optional local path to the vendor-redlined .docx file.

baseline_docx_path.description: Optional local path to the standard baseline .docx file.

tools.name: analyze_clause_precedents
tools.description: Run live BigQuery Vector Search (VECTOR_SEARCH with text-embedding-005 COSINE distance) and statistical COUNTIF distribution across historical aerospace deals for a redlined clause.

clause_id.description: Canonical clause identifier (e.g., GP1-12, GP1-19, SP3-04, SP5-03).

top_k.description: Number of top semantic precedent matches to return.

tools.name: record_sme_position
tools.description: Record an SME team's clause review position (hold_firm, compromise_tier_1, accept_vendor, or harmonized_tariff_cap) in BigQuery, evaluate machine-enforced regulatory lockouts and cross-clause conflicts, and append an immutable audit event.

annotations.title: Record SME Clause Position & Check Conflicts

tools.name: harmonize_clause_conflict
tools.description: Deterministically resolve a cross-clause conflict (such as CONFLICT-SP3-04-GP1-03 between SP3 §4.1 Tariffs and GP1 §3.1 Firm-Fixed-Price SOW Cap) by applying the harmonized cap in BigQuery.

tools.name: export_counter_proposal_package
tools.description: Verify all SME sign-offs and zero active conflicts, generate the 12-clause Counter-Proposal .docx with native Word Track Changes (<w:ins>, <w:del>, <w:comment>) and 4-tab SharePoint Deviation Matrix .xlsx, and return download URLs plus M365 connector drafts.

tools.name: reset_deal_workbench
tools.description: Reset the deal workbench in BigQuery to its canonical post-ingestion triage state.
